messages:
maria (sec): Quick check before we approve this deploy — can someone confirm the minimum TLS version enforced at the LB and which KMS key the control-plane is using? Audit asked for rotation schedule and rotation proof. cc @devin @sasha

devin (infra): For public endpoints the LB enforces TLS1.2+, internal mTLS is TLS1.3. Which control-plane host are you looking at?

sasha (eng-runtime): This is the control-plane API (api.ctrl.redwood). Current LB cipher: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, negotiated TLS1.2 in a few client traces. We planned a TLS1.3 flip but haven't pushed live yet.

kevin (devops): KMS key for control-plane resources: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/control-plane/cryptoKeys/cp-main-2024. Rotation policy is set to 90d by Ops for PCI scope (overrides default annual).

maria (sec): Perfect — can you point me to rotation logs for audit? Need evidence of last rotation + IAM who triggered it.

devin (infra): Yep — Cloud Audit Logs show the RotateKey calls. Quick query I run: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=\"global\" AND protoPayload.methodName:\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.UpdateCryptoKey\"' --limit 10`
Last two relevant lines from logs: `protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: ops-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `protoPayload.request.name: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/control-plane/cryptoKeys/cp-main-2024`

sasha (eng-runtime): Note: TLS termination is at the LB (nginx+gcp LB). If we update the LB config to prefer TLS1.3 the pods stay the same. We should smoke-test clients that still present TLS1.2.

ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2026-05-02T03:00:00Z. Rollback policy: auto-fallback to previous TLS cipher suite if health checks fail.

maria (sec): Action items: @devin upload rotation policy & rotation evidence to Confluence, @sasha schedule TLS1.3 flip + smoke tests, @kevin ensure audit logs are exported to long-term storage and security has access. I'll mark resolved after links.

devin (infra): Done — uploaded: https://confluence.internal/redwood/security/ks-controlplane-rotation (permission: security@redwood has view).

kevin (devops): Logs exported to s3://redwood-audit/control-plane-kms/2026/ — granted read to security@redwood.

sasha (eng-runtime): PR created for LB config and smoke test script. Quick smoke command we used locally:
```
kubectl run tls-smoke --rm -i --restart=Never --image=curlimages/curl -- bash -c "curl -v --tls-max 1.3 https://api.ctrl.redwood/health || true"
```
Will run in canary and report back.

maria (sec): :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll verify the Confluence links + S3 export and close the ticket. If anyone sees TLS1.0/1.1 in traces, ping me immediately.

kevin (devops): noted. leaving a short note in the runbook about the KMS key owner and 90d rotation.

sasha (eng-runtime): will post smoke results in this thread once done.

maria (sec): resolved for now, marking as awaiting smoke + audit evidence. Thanks everyone.
